resources.string: See outfits on you before you wear them
Build a digital closet from the clothes you already own.
Pick a top and bottom, or a full-body piece, and see how it looks on your baseline photo.
Your photos stay on this device
Your baseline photo and garment images are stored in the app only. Nothing is uploaded by this step.
Veste AI uses the camera to take a full-body photo of you as your baseline. The photo never leaves your device.
You can try again, or choose a photo from your gallery instead.
Android will not show the prompt again. Turn on Camera in app settings to continue.
Stand about two metres from the camera in a neutral pose, with your whole body from head to toe inside the outline.
